question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **"introduce"**.
 
• **Introduce**: It means to bring something new into existence or to present something for the first time. (परिचय देना)
 
 
• **Example**: *I will introduce you to my friend at the party tonight.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the passage, it aligns with the idea of implementing new service innovations to meet those expectations.
 
• Hence,** "introduce" **should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 3"**.
